name: The Fool
traditional_meaning: Freeing yourself from limitation; expressing joy and youthful vigor; being open-minded.
traditional_reversed: Being gullible and naive; taking unnecessary risks; failing to be serious when required.
fortune_telling: Watch for new projects and new beginnings
Prepare to take something on faith
Something new comes your way; go for it

name: The Magician
traditional_meaning: Taking appropriate action; receiving guidance from a higher power; becoming a channel of divine will.
traditional_reversed: Inflating your own ego; abusing talents; manipulating or deceiving others.
fortune_telling: A powerful man may play a role in your day
Your current situation must be seen as one element of a much larger plan

name: The High Priestess
traditional_meaning: Listening to your feelings and intuitions; exploring unconventional spirituality; keeping secrets.
traditional_reversed: Being aloof; obsessing on secrets and conspiracies; rejecting guidance from spirit or intuition.
fortune_telling: A mysterious woman arrives
A sexual secret may surface
Someone knows more than he or she will reveal

name: The Empress
traditional_meaning: Nurturing yourself and others; bearing fruit; celebrating your body.
traditional_reversed: Overindulging; being greedy; smothering someone with attention.
fortune_telling: Pregnancy is in the cards
An opportunity to be involved in luxurious sexuality is coming
Beware a tendency toward addiction

name: The Emperor
traditional_meaning: Exercising authority; defining limits; directing the flow of work.
traditional_reversed: Micromanaging; crushing the creativity of others with a rigid, iron-fisted approach; insisting on getting your own way.
fortune_telling: A father figure arrives
A new employer or authority figure will give you orders
Expect discipline or correction in the near future

name: The Hierophant
traditional_meaning: Teaching or guiding others; searching for the truth; asking for guidance from a higher power.
traditional_reversed: Using experience as a means of manipulating or misguiding others; being dogmatic; favoring tradition over what is expedient or necessary.
fortune_telling: Expect to be caught in a misdeed and punished accordingly
Pray for forgiveness and confess wrongdoings
A more experienced man, spiritual leader, or father figure will come into your life

name: The Lovers
traditional_meaning: Being in love; showing your love to others; expressing passion or romantic feelings.
traditional_reversed: Debilitating passion; allowing an unhealthy desire for love to motivate destructive behavior; disrupting unity.
fortune_telling: A new personal or professional relationship blossoms
Sexual opportunities abound
Unexpectedly, a friend becomes a lover

name: The Chariot
traditional_meaning: Breaking through barriers; moving forward with confidence and authority; reaching the pinnacle of success.
traditional_reversed: Resting on laurels; riding roughshod over the feelings or expectations of others; focusing more on past successes than future opportunities.
fortune_telling: Victory is a certainty
Move ahead with all plans
Beware the jealousy of others

name: Strength
traditional_meaning: Imposing restrictions on yourself for your own benefit; bringing your passions under the control of reason; resisting impulses that work against your best interests.
traditional_reversed: Indulging weakness, even when you know it will damage your health and happiness; languishing in addiction; allowing your instincts to tame and conquer you.
fortune_telling: Your self-control will be tested
A woman will seek to change her partner or lover
You are a strong, capable person

name: The Hermit
traditional_meaning: Becoming or seeking out a guru; going on a retreat; recharging spiritual or creative batteries.
traditional_reversed: Being a loner; fearing contact with others; becoming a know-it-all.
fortune_telling: A period of loneliness begins
One partner in a relationship departs
A search for love or money proves fruitless

name: Wheel of Fortune
traditional_meaning: Allowing events to unfold; seeing the larger pattern in everyday events; trusting your luck.
traditional_reversed: Losing money gambling; refusing to do your part to bring a plan to fruition; taking a fatalistic approach to life.
fortune_telling: Some events are in the hands of heaven
You've lived through this before
What happened then?

name: Justice
traditional_meaning: Making an objective decision; weighing an issue carefully before taking action; appropriately scaling your reaction to a situation.
traditional_reversed: Delivering harsh criticism; obsessing on rules and regulations; playing by the book even when it is destructive or counterproductive to do so.
fortune_telling: A legal verdict will be rendered soon
Someone is making a decision
You need to get the facts

name: The Hanged Man
traditional_meaning: Seeing growth opportunities in unpleasant events; experiencing a dramatic change in personal perspective; making the best of an unforeseen change in your life or work.
traditional_reversed: Being untrue to yourself and your values; refusing to make sacrifices when appropriate; refusing to adapt to new situations.
fortune_telling: A traitor is revealed
One of your friends is working against you
Change your ways or suffer the consequences

name: Death
traditional_meaning: Bringing an unpleasant phase of life to an end; recognizing and celebrating the conclusion of something; putting bad habits to rest.
traditional_reversed: Obsessing on death and dying; refusing to give up old habits or unhealthy relationships; insisting that everything and everyone should stay the same forever.
fortune_telling: A relationship or illness ends suddenly
Limit travel and risk-taking
General gloom and doom

name: Temperance
traditional_meaning: Bringing opposites together; moderating your actions or emotions; finding middle ground.
traditional_reversed: Going to extremes; disrupting group efforts; ignoring healthy approaches to life.
fortune_telling: Someone's using drugs or alcohol to excess
It's time to get back on that diet

name: The Devil
traditional_meaning: Appreciating the luxuries that life has to offer; being comfortable in your own skin; enjoying your sexuality.
traditional_reversed: Putting excessive emphasis on appearances; always wanting more; valuing possessions more than people or relationships.
fortune_telling: Adultery and unfaithfulness
A string of extremely bad luck is coming your way
Beware evil influences and wolves in sheep's clothing

name: The Tower
traditional_meaning: Breaking out of old, confining habits and mindsets; clearing the way for new growth; dispelling the influence of an inflated ego.
traditional_reversed: Clinging to traditions that repress growth; engaging in willful blindness; rejecting evidence that change is needed.
fortune_telling: Impending disaster
Cancel plans and reverse decisions
Someone wants to take you down a notch or two
Don't hold back; say what you really mean

name: The Star
traditional_meaning: Hoping for the best; believing good things happen to good people; seeing events in the best possible light.
traditional_reversed: Denying unpleasant truths; denying personal accountability and saying, "Things just happen!"; ignoring signs and omens.
fortune_telling: Get an astrology chart drawn up
Someone is a little too starstruck
What's happening now has long been fore-ordained

name: The Moon
traditional_meaning: Enjoying healthy fantasies and daydreams; using your imagination; practicing magic or celebrating the magic of everyday life.
traditional_reversed: Becoming unable to separate fantasy from reality; suffering from delusions; losing your appreciation for the fantastic or magical.
fortune_telling: Watch for problems at the end of the month
Someone you know needs to howl at the moon more often
Someone is about to change his or her mind about an important decision

name: The Sun
traditional_meaning: Seeing things clearly; experiencing intense joy; celebrating your own successes.
traditional_reversed: Being dazzled by your own accomplishments; becoming absorbed in your own self-image; feeling rushed and distracted.
fortune_telling: Everything's coming up roses (or sunflowers, whatever the case may be)
Whatever's on your mind, go for it because you can't lose today

name: Judgement
traditional_meaning: Receiving a wake-up call; discovering a new purpose in life; becoming totally and completely yourself.
traditional_reversed: Being weighed in the balances and found wanting; failing to measure up to a well-defined standard; being caught goofing off or misbehaving.
fortune_telling: An old issue you thought was over will come up again today
Get ready for huge changes: break-ups, sudden calls from old friends, and unexpected setbacks
God's trying to get your attention

name: The World
traditional_meaning: Having it all; knowing and loving yourself as completely as possible; seeing the interconnection of all things and people.
traditional_reversed: Allowing greed and envy to prevent you from enjoying what you do possess; failing to see the larger design in ordinary events; believing that everything that exists can be touched, counted, or measured.
fortune_telling: Winning the lottery
Getting your heart's desire
Having everything you ever imagined having

name: Ace of Cups
traditional_meaning: Trusting your feelings; opening yourself to spirit; accepting and returning affection.
traditional_reversed: Hiding your feelings; spurning an opportunity to love or be loved; numbing yourself to spiritual yearnings.
fortune_telling: Romance is in the cards
A new relationship or marriage is just around the corner
Prayers are answered

name: Two of Cups
traditional_meaning: Being drawn to someone; longing for someone or something; acting on your desires.
traditional_reversed: Burning bridges; becoming caught up in unhealthy codependency; shutting out anyone but your chosen few.
fortune_telling: Someone has a secret crush on you
Relationships should be mutual; get rid of a leech

name: Three of Cups
traditional_meaning: Celebrating your feelings or connections with others; expressing joy through song, dance, or physical affection; working together with others who share your feelings.
traditional_reversed: Mistaking giddiness for true affection; being dominated by manic emotions; expecting everyone to always feel the same way you do.
fortune_telling: Unconventional romance is coming your way: a love affair with someone you've always dismissed

name: Four of Cups
traditional_meaning: Maintaining your emotional stability; refusing to give in to overwhelming emotions; appreciating what you have and refusing to take it for granted.
traditional_reversed: Being bored; daydreaming at the expense of your work; refusing to be engaged by opportunity.
fortune_telling: A lover is getting restless
Find out what he or she needs, or new opportunities may lure your partner away

name: Five of Cups
traditional_meaning: Acknowledging loss and moving on; focusing on how the glass remains "half-full"; finding the silver lining in a dark cloud.
traditional_reversed: Wallowing in unhealthy grief or self-pity; refusing to move on and let go; clinging to the past.
fortune_telling: A breakup looms
Don't cry over spilt milk
Take your lumps and get back in the saddle

name: Six of Cups
traditional_meaning: Donating your time and talents to others; taking satisfaction in knowing how your efforts will aid others; creating a "win-win" scenario.
traditional_reversed: Linking your sense of self-worth to the appraisals of others; striving to appear more needy than you really are; taking undeserved or unmerited charity.
fortune_telling: A stingy spirit is strangling your enjoyment of life
Loosen up and think of others for once, why don't you?

name: Seven of Cups
traditional_meaning: Motivating yourself with images of future success; using visualization to encourage progress; taking an imaginative or creative approach to problem solving.
traditional_reversed: Obsessing on imaginary fears or uncertain consequences; giving in to emotional or political terrorism; spending more time dreaming than working.
fortune_telling: You're being fed a line
Rather than be dazzled by fancy words and promises, demand something real

name: Eight of Cups
traditional_meaning: Wanting something better; blazing your own trail; realizing there must be more to life.
traditional_reversed: Being implacable; finding fault; nitpicking.
fortune_telling: Someone's "stepping out" on you, now or in the near future
Maybe it's time to quit talking about the problem and just move on

name: Nine of Cups
traditional_meaning: Being delighted with your own achievements; recognizing your own talents and abilities; reveling in the good things life has to offer.
traditional_reversed: Being smug; satisfying yourself at the expense of others; being selfish.
fortune_telling: Whatever you want, you'll get it

name: Ten of Cups
traditional_meaning: Having more than you ever dreamed; being deeply thankful for all you've been given; recognizing the Hand of God in the gifts the Universe brings your way.
traditional_reversed: Comparing your achievements or relationships to unrealistic fantasy standards; experiencing emotions so intense they blunt your ability to cope with reality; feeling overwhelmed.
fortune_telling: Marriage and family are in the cards
Expect a friendship to blossom into a romance

name: Page of Cups
traditional_meaning: Showing your emotions freely; throwing yourself into romance; nursing a secret crush.
traditional_reversed: Mistaking a crush for true love; reading romantic intention into innocent action; frantically trying to impress others.
fortune_telling: This card represents a young man or woman with a watery, dreamy demeanor, likely born a Libra, Scorpio, or Sagittarius, who wants to start a new relationship with you

name: Knight of Cups
traditional_meaning: Being deeply committed to a cause; giving in to strong emotions, from excitement to depression; acting on intuition alone.
traditional_reversed: Becoming a fanatic; rejecting information that suggests your intuitions are misguided; allowing your emotions to control you.
fortune_telling: This card represents a man with an emotional, sensitive personality, likely born between October 13th and November 11th, who wants you to rally around his latest passionate cause

name: Queen of Cups
traditional_meaning: Allowing yourself to be moved by the plight of others; feeling strong emotions; possessing unusual sympathy or empathy.
traditional_reversed: Becoming so caught up in matters of Spirit, you become detached from the world; allowing empathy to disable you (instead of inspire action); using psychic abilities to wield covert influence.
fortune_telling: This card represents a woman with an emotional, deeply spiritual nature, likely born between June 11th and July 11th, who uses emotional and spiritual appeals to sway others to her point of view

name: King of Cups
traditional_meaning: Keeping a stiff upper lip; being brave and clear in the face of adverse circumstances; sharing experience as a way of comforting others.
traditional_reversed: Allowing yourself to become rigid and unemotional; making unfair decisions based on a hidden agenda; making decisions without regard for their emotional impact on others.
fortune_telling: This card represents an older man with a gentle, sensitive presence, likely born between February 9th and March 10th, who is known for his fairness and tolerance

name: Ace of Swords
traditional_meaning: Making objective decisions; applying logic; reasoning your way out of a difficult situation.
traditional_reversed: Applying ruthless or twisted logic; gloating over your own superior intellect; using quick thinking to deceive or confuse others.
fortune_telling: The time to make a choice is now
Stop wavering and do what you know is best

name: Two of Swords
traditional_meaning: Refusing to make a decision without getting the facts; exploring both sides of an argument; arguing passionately for what you believe in.
traditional_reversed: Rejecting evidence that conflicts with dearly-held beliefs; arguing with others just for the sake of doing so; nit-picking.
fortune_telling: Sometimes, the only way to win is to refuse to fight
You're stuck for now; let time pass before taking action

name: Three of Swords
traditional_meaning: Being brave enough to see things as they really are; exercising your critical eye; being your own best critic.
traditional_reversed: Wallowing in despair; allowing yourself to be completely crushed by the thoughts, words, or deeds of another; judging yourself too harshly.
fortune_telling: Breakups and infidelity abound
What hurts now, though, will turn out to be good for you later on

name: Four of Swords
traditional_meaning: Thinking over your plans before putting them into action; pausing to meditate or clear your mind; taking time to understand someone or something before criticizing it.
traditional_reversed: Failing to think things through; mistaking procrastination for thoughtfulness; adopting a point of view and refusing to reconsider your conclusions, even when presented with refuting evidence.
fortune_telling: Don't make any decision now
Wait, and you'll be glad you did

name: Five of Swords
traditional_meaning: Acting in your own best interest; choosing to stand up for yourself; not backing down from disagreement and discord.
traditional_reversed: Taking advantage of others; intimidating others; acting in an unethical manner.
fortune_telling: Someone is stealing from you, financially or romantically
Be wary of friends who talk behind your back

name: Six of Swords
traditional_meaning: Making the best of a bad situation; recovering from defeat; resetting expectations.
traditional_reversed: Refusing to accept that things have changed; playing the victim; rejecting the idea that your actions have consequences.
fortune_telling: You'll soon go on a long journey over water
Actions have unexpected consequences, so be prepared

name: Seven of Swords
traditional_meaning: Refusing to do something dishonest, even when there's no chance of ever being caught; handling a difficult situation with finesse; pointing out assumptions.
traditional_reversed: Stealing or lying; doing whatever you can get away with, simply because you can; looking for a way around consequences.
fortune_telling: Don't assume people around you are worthy of your trust
Ask for an accounting of where people have been, and what they've been doing

name: Eight of Swords
traditional_meaning: Honoring limits; respecting the rules; deciding to go on a diet for your health's sake.
traditional_reversed: Feeling trapped; being lost in a maze of rules and regulations; giving in to despair.
fortune_telling: Get over playing the victim
Once you realize you are your own biggest obstacle, nothing can hold you back

name: Nine of Swords
traditional_meaning: Refusing to worry about what you cannot control; rejecting anxiety; judging your own performance with kindness and gentleness.
traditional_reversed: Torturing yourself with regrets; second-guessing your every move; beating yourself up for your mistakes.
fortune_telling: If you take the action you're considering now, you'll be sorry in the future

name: Ten of Swords
traditional_meaning: Seeing the signs that you've reached your limits; paying attention to what your body is trying to tell you; giving in to the need for rest and renewal.
traditional_reversed: Accepting defeat prematurely; driving yourself to total exhaustion, especially mentally; experiencing a mental breakdown.
fortune_telling: Disaster
Put off plans and do not take action until omens are better

name: Page of Swords
traditional_meaning: Pursuing a course of study; asking good questions; investing time in study and practice.
traditional_reversed: Pretending to knowledge or sophistication you do not possess; cheating on an exam; feigning interest as a way of gaining favor.
fortune_telling: This card represents a young man or woman with an airy, intellectual demeanor, likely born a Capricorn, Aquarius, or Pisces, who wants to learn something new from you or have a discussion with you

name: Knight of Swords
traditional_meaning: Speaking your mind; making your opinions known; offering constructive criticism.
traditional_reversed: Stating your opinions as fact; picking fights; starting arguments.
fortune_telling: A blunder leads someone to say something he or she regrets
If this was you, be prepared to apologize and move on

name: Queen of Swords
traditional_meaning: Exercising tact or using diplomacy; defusing a tense situation; knowing what to say and how to say it.
traditional_reversed: Knowing exactly what to say to destroy another person; withholding critical information; using a barbed tongue to upset others.
fortune_telling: This card represents a woman with an artistic, intellectual nature, likely born between September 12th and October 12th, who uses clever, positive communication to sway others to her point of view

name: King of Swords
traditional_meaning: Expressing yourself with firmness and authority; rendering a final decision; consulting an expert.
traditional_reversed: Insisting on having the last word; flaunting your intellectual capability; talking "over the heads" of others.
fortune_telling: This card represents an older man with an insightful, deliberate spirit, likely born between May 11th and June 10th, who is known for his integrity and sharp decision-making ability

name: Ace of Wands
traditional_meaning: Being inspired; identifying an important goal; being given the opportunity to do whatever you want to do.
traditional_reversed: Failing to take advantage of a great opportunity; being ineffectual or lazy; making an inadequate effort.
fortune_telling: Someone has the "hots" for you
A new job offer is coming your way
Walk softly, and carry a big stick

name: Two of Wands
traditional_meaning: Having a choice; offering or being offered an option; seeing the value of another person's approach.
traditional_reversed: Misrepresenting your intentions; doing one thing while desiring another; changing course mid-stream for no good reason.
fortune_telling: Beware false friends
Don't be mealy-mouthed; say what you think and do what you want to do

name: Three of Wands
traditional_meaning: Putting a plan into motion; taking that critical first step; making good things happen.
traditional_reversed: Procrastinating; knowing what to do, but refusing to do it; launching a project without a clear definition of who should do what.
fortune_telling: You'll be planning a trip soon
Be on the lookout: your ship is coming in

name: Four of Wands
traditional_meaning: Sharing in a great celebration; sharing in a communal sense of achievement and success; preparing for a party.
traditional_reversed: Keeping your nose to the grindstone; recognizing good work by demanding more work; failing to share in a group celebration.
fortune_telling: Someone is watching and evaluating your work
You may get a wedding invitation soon

name: Five of Wands
traditional_meaning: Calmly expressing a dissenting opinion; allowing someone to use his or her own methods to get a job done; opening the floor for discussion or debate.
traditional_reversed: Berating others for their ridiculous opinions; picking fights; offering destructive criticism.
fortune_telling: Prepare for a fight with your best friend
Remember: once you let words loose, you can't take them back

name: Six of Wands
traditional_meaning: Outperforming your peers; winning a competition; being recognized as a capable person.
traditional_reversed: Being a bad winner; allowing your achievements to inflate your ego; looking down on people who seem less capable.
fortune_telling: Someone is planning a party for you, but not everyone feels so good about your recent success
Watch out for envious friends

name: Seven of Wands
traditional_meaning: Refusing to be silenced through fear or intimidation; continuing a fight against all odds; being fierce.
traditional_reversed: Having a chip on your shoulder; taking unnecessary risks as a means of proving your fearlessness; looking for an opportunity to take offense.
fortune_telling: Don't be surprised by a personal attack
Prepare to defend yourself or someone you love

name: Eight of Wands
traditional_meaning: Taking swift action; moving forward with a plan as quickly as possible; energizing yourself.
traditional_reversed: Giving in to panic; running in circles and screaming; insisting things must always stay the same.
fortune_telling: Watch for a surprising letter in the mail
Your whole world is about to be turned on its ear

name: Nine of Wands
traditional_meaning: Sticking with it for the duration; fulfilling your promises and obligations; bearing up under incredible duress.
traditional_reversed: Making yourself a martyr; abandoning your post; giving up at the first sign of opposition.
fortune_telling: Don't relax yet; there's more to come
The test you're facing now is happening for one reason: to show you who your real friends are

name: Ten of Wands
traditional_meaning: Holding your own in extreme circumstances; helping others carry their burdens; coming to the aid of the oppressed.
traditional_reversed: Taking on more work than you know you can handle; refusing to say "No" when you're already overloaded; making a habit of working overtime.
fortune_telling: You're worn out
Back off, take a time out, and let someone else handle things for a while

name: Page of Wands
traditional_meaning: Leaping at a new opportunity; being a cheerleader or ardent advocate for your cause; being a True Believer.
traditional_reversed: Basing your entire self-image on what others think; seizing every new idea that comes your way without question; habitually discounting input or feedback from others.
fortune_telling: This card represents a young man or woman with a fiery, enthusiastic demeanor, likely born a Cancer, Leo, or Virgo, who wants to start a new relationship with you

name: Knight of Wands
traditional_meaning: Charging ahead; making rapid progress; refusing limits.
traditional_reversed: Blundering forward with inadequate skill or information; running roughshod over the feelings of others; using sex appeal to manipulate others.
fortune_telling: This card represents a man with a bold, passionate personality, likely born between July 12th and August 11th, who wants to sweep you off your feet

name: Queen of Wands
traditional_meaning: Paying close attention; helping others focus on the issue at hand; getting everyone to work together.
traditional_reversed: Being distracted, or using your charms or skills to distract others from the goal; calling attention to yourself with negative or unhealthy behaviors; disrupting group activities as a means of feeding your own ego.
fortune_telling: This card represents a woman with an attractive, appealing personality, likely born between March 11th and April 20th, who wants to charm you into doing things her way

name: King of Wands
traditional_meaning: Putting old things together in new and exciting ways; coming up with unexpected solutions; using your experience to solve puzzles and problems.
traditional_reversed: Using your creativity to get out of honest work; investing great energy in avoiding responsibility; boasting about achievements without putting your expertise to practical use.
fortune_telling: This card represents an older man with a commanding, charismatic personality, likely born between November 13th and December 12th, who prefers to give directions and have them followed

name: Ace of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Outlining a plan for achieving prosperity; becoming aware of opportunities to improve income or health; realizing you have everything you need.
traditional_reversed: Indulging in relentless consumerism; wanting more, no matter how much you have; obsessing on your account balance.
fortune_telling: Your health will improve
The check you're looking for really is in the mail

name: Two of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Weighing options; comparing prices; determining the value of one option over another.
traditional_reversed: Engaging in endless price comparison; putting off a buying decision for fear of finding a slightly better value later on; buying something without regard for value.
fortune_telling: It's time to balance the budget
Avoid the temptation to spend critical funds on frivolous goods

name: Three of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Finishing a project; setting and meeting standards; performing according to specifications.
traditional_reversed: Pandering to the tastes of others; failing to deliver what you've promised; not delivering your best work unless closely supervised.
fortune_telling: A high-dollar contract is in your future
If you work hard, you'll succeed

name: Four of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Saving for a rainy day; fasting as part of a spiritual practice; dieting in an effort to improve your body.
traditional_reversed: Being stingy; refusing to spend money that needs to be spent; withholding sex from your partner.
fortune_telling: A rainy day is coming—it's time to save

name: Five of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Recognizing your needs and taking action to fulfill them; doing as much as you can do with what little you have; admitting you need help.
traditional_reversed: Exaggerating your financial or physical needs; adopting a poverty mentality; refusing to support yourself.
fortune_telling: Finances are getting tighter
Prepare for a setback

name: Six of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Giving time, money, or effort to a charity; taking part in a group effort; lending your resources to others without expecting anything in return.
traditional_reversed: Making a loan as a means of gaining control over someone; using charitable acts to draw attention to yourself; dividing work or resources unfairly.
fortune_telling: When you need help, ask for it
Remember, though: what you receive may be limited by what you've given to others in the past

name: Seven of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Measuring progress toward your goal; looking at results with an eye toward improving performance; asking, "How happy am I?".
traditional_reversed: Becoming distracted by melancholy thoughts; longing for "the good old days"; beating yourself up over lost opportunities.
fortune_telling: Things won't work out as expected
Pick up the pieces and prepare to move on

name: Eight of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Doing your best; bringing enthusiasm and zeal to your work; making an effort to be the best you can be.
traditional_reversed: Working yourself to death; doing a half-hearted or sloppy job; continuing in a job you hate.
fortune_telling: Stop over-analyzing, researching, and outlining
Buckle down and get the work done

name: Nine of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Investing time in learning or teaching a difficult task; restraining yourself from physical or financial extremes; making sacrifices as a way of achieving larger goals.
traditional_reversed: Being assigned to a task without being trained to perform it; pursuing a position for which you are not qualified; disregarding requirements.
fortune_telling: Until you appreciate what you have, you won't have any luck getting more

name: Ten of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Celebrating your physical and financial blessings; realizing how lucky or how blessed you are; being satisfied with your physical and financial achievements.
traditional_reversed: Spending all of your money on extravagant gifts and possessions; trying too hard to impress others with your wealth or physique; giving an inappropriately expensive gift as a means of currying favor.
fortune_telling: Big money is in the near future
Expect a powerful blessing to come your way

name: Page of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Learning the value of a dollar; starting a savings plan; taking the first steps toward getting out of debt.
traditional_reversed: Trying to appear healthier or wealthier than you really are; spending money carelessly; living strictly for today, with no thought of tomorrow.
fortune_telling: This card represents a young man or woman with an earthy, practical demeanor, likely born an Aries, Taurus, or Gemini, who playfully encourages you to take financial or sexual risks

name: Knight of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Spending money wisely; saving for a rainy day; paying close attention to physical or financial details.
traditional_reversed: Throwing caution to the four winds; spending without regard for consequence; spending on luxury when necessities are lacking.
fortune_telling: A stingy person may chide you for spending money
Be prepared to defend an economic or sexual decision

name: Queen of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Appreciating fine food, fine wine, beautiful art, beautiful bodies, or any of the better things in life; reveling in healthy sexuality; treating yourself.
traditional_reversed: Indulging in gluttony or greediness; becoming insatiable; blunting the impact of treats by indulging in them too often.
fortune_telling: This card represents a woman with an expansive, sensual nature, likely born between December 13th and 31st, who uses sensual appeal and the promise of reward to sway others to her point of view

name: King of Pentacles
traditional_meaning: Becoming debt-free; having more than enough to get by; making contributions to a savings plan.
traditional_reversed: Becoming so conservative you resist all change on principle alone; ignoring innovations in the name of preserving tradition; being smug or cocky.
fortune_telling: This card represents an older man with a financially, socially, and politically conservative spirit, likely born between August 12th and September 11th, who is known for putting his money where his mouth is
